messages:
maria_cs: FYI — NOVAHealth hit a token-bucket alert this morning. QBR prep next Tue; can we get a crisp cost summary + mitigation playbook?
raj_k: Ack. Noted the spike — looks embedding-heavy based on quick sample. Do we have per-route breakdowns?
jordyn_eng: I pulled logs, here's the quick snippet:```route: /embed/create tokens: 890k day: 2026-03-20 top_client: nova.health``` we can run prefix caching and reduce repeated prefix tokens by ~15-25% for that route.
sam_solutions: I can run a short enablement workshop with their ML team — focus on batching + prompt-length guidance. Would like the exact top queries to prepare examples.
alyssa_fin: Need a 30/90d spend forecast to show to AM. If we do caching + light quantization on dedicated, what's the estimated monthly cost delta? Ballpark numbers are fine.
maria_cs: Good — action items: (1) jordyn: per-route delta with caching on/off (2) raj: compile top-10 user journeys and callers (3) sam: draft enablement agenda (4) alyssa: prepare forecast slide and renewal ask recommendation.
raj_k: I'll export top callers — any PII redaction required?
maria_cs: redact uuids/userids, keep usage shape. share via encrypted GDrive link.
jordyn_eng: Quick config we can test:```enable_prefix_cache: true
cache_ttl_seconds: 600
batch_window_ms: 20``` Should be safe for NOVA's pattern. I'll spin a canary and run a 24h sim.
alert-bot: [automated] token-bucket alert created for account nova.health at 2026-03-20T09:12:08Z, burst=890123 tokens, threshold=500000.
sam_solutions: +1 to canary. Also will record a 30-min async video for the customer showing how to reduce context length and set embedding truncation.
alyssa_fin: If caching reduces tokens 20% and we keep churn, we can present a conservative commit ask: 6M/month commit vs current projected 8.4M. I'll draft slide with two scenarios (conservative/optimistic).
maria_cs: Timeline: jordyn sends results by EOD tomorrow, raj sends caller export by EOD, sam sends draft agenda by EOD. alyssa will share forecast slides by EOD Thurs. I'll assemble QBR packet and send draft to AM for review Fri.
raj_k: on it. 
jordyn_eng: Can confirm canary tomorrow AM. tagging @sam_solutions for test data.
sam_solutions: got it. I'll pull example prompts and line up the enablement session for Wed next week (pre-QBR).
maria_cs: Perfect. If anyone uncovers anything blocking (legal/PII/regulatory) call it out here — otherwise we'll proceed with the mitigation playbook. :thumbsup:
